paragraphs: A shift begins with reviewing workpieces and drawing tolerances and selecting abrasive grit and wheels. Workers grind each item by hand, control force, inspect reflections, switch abrasives for finishing, measure dimensions, polish custom shapes, remove debris, inspect equipment, and hand work to quality control.
In short, they make part surfaces bright and accurate. They perform handheld grinding, control force while deburring, polish, and inspect their own work, combining judgment with manual skill.
